Provides a small collection of higher-order functions for functional-style programming in R, including 'Curry' (partial application), 'CurryL' (lazy partial application), 'Compose' (function composition, including a multi-argument variant), 'Identity', 'Negate' and 'Swap'.

name: r-functional
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.7" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-functional
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/functional_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/functional/functional_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f87d9d0a8a0ab1052a3629f54eeaaeef60de70482cd9e17f215cc1387019d104

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-lisp >=0.2
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-lisp >=0.2

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('functional')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('functional')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/klutometis/R-functional
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: Provides a small collection of higher-order functions for functional-style programming
    in R, including 'Curry' (partial application), 'CurryL' (lazy partial application),
    'Compose' (function composition, including a multi-argument variant), 'Identity',
    'Negate' and 'Swap'.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2'

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
